title: Assessments, etc., prima facie proof.
bodyText:
GENERAL PROVISIONS

The effect of the notices of assessments and records prepared by or under the authority of the department of taxation shall be as set forth in sections 231-20 and 235-107.
bodyHtml:
GENERAL PROVISIONS

 

     §235-115  Assessments, etc., prima facie proof.  The effect of the notices of assessments and records prepared by or under the authority of the department of taxation shall be as set forth in sections 231-20 and 235-107. [L Sp 1957, c 1, pt of §2; am L Sp 1959 2d, c 1, §16; Supp, §121-47; HRS §235-115]
